title: Many follicles from few donors do not equal many independent human replicates

extreme_check.interpretation: if follicles within each donor are perfectly redundant, 30 follicle measurements contain only three donor-level units of independent information under this toy model

HF01_implication: follicle count must not be reported as independent human sample count
donor/region/follicle hierarchy belongs in the analysis model
random follicle train/test splits can leak donor-specific structure
donor-held-out validation is necessary for donor-generalization claims but can still be unstable with very few donors
repeated time points within a follicle add another dependence layer and are not independent rows
claim_boundary: The equal-cluster design-effect formula is a planning surrogate, not a substitute for the actual hierarchical model, and does not provide a power calculation for a future HF01 study.
